freeze_basis: Frozen on 2026-11-25 using 2017 validation only. Verified the stored SHA-256 of both candidates and the supervised dataset. The same-hour evaluation uses observed historical weather and the original train-fitted transformations.

model_selection.classification: highest validation F1 at default 0.5 threshold

classification_decision: saved estimator predict; keep default class decision and existing tie behavior
slice_reporting: Report observed counts, actual positive counts, MAE and confusion counts. Mark undefined precision/recall as unavailable. Weather forms part of the proxy definition; interpret groups descriptively.
holdout_policy: Score the saved candidates once on all 2018 test observations; no refit, threshold adjustment or reselection using these outcomes.
